turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My nephew turns ten next week and loves board games.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Nice. Would he like something competitive where he can beat the grown-ups, or a cooperative game where everyone plays together?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey, can you stay quiet for a minute? I need to talk to my partner. I'll come back to you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Grace, is it still raining out there?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Just drizzling now. The sky looks lighter over the hills.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you think it'll clear up in time for the market?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Maybe. If not, we can just take umbrellas. It's only a ten minute walk.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done with the dishes, your turn.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Just that the bus was late again.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: True. I really want those peaches before they sell out.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Then let's not wait too long. Grab your jacket.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done talking to them. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good to have you back. We were choosing a board game for a ten year old.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Cooperative. He gets upset when he loses.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good thinking. Forbidden Island is a great one, the whole family wins or loses together.
